# Hi, I'm Sasha, welcome to my website!

I'm a PhD student in the Clinical Translational Science program at Case Western Reserve University, where I study heart brain dynamics and how we can see them with advanced imaging techniques.

Before Case Western, I worked in the Department of Neurosurgery at Stanford Medicine, coordinating clinical trials and doing cerebrovascular MRI research, especially arterial spin labeling (ASL) perfusion imaging.

Outside the lab, I'm a licensed private pilot, and I speak French, Arabic, and some Farsi.

Some of my favorite hobbies include baking and cooking! 

Feel free to [email me](mailto:sxa1829@case.edu). I'm always happy to talk science (or exchanging recipes) :)
